en: Sepia photograph of a large three-story military barracks building with a hipped roof and a small cupola, seen from a corner in an open square. Pedestrians and a horse-drawn cart pass by in the foreground. Caption at top lists the city name in Romanian, German, and Hungarian and identifies the building as the Mihai Viteazul Barracks. The reverse side is a divided back printed in Romanian with the publisher credit and a handwritten name.
